DSG vs CVT vs AMT - Which Automatic Transmission Is Best for India?

Here is a quick breakdown to help you decide.

DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox)
Best for: Sporty driving, premium cars (VW, Audi, Skoda)
Pros: Fast gear shifts, great performance
Watch out for: Needs specialist servicing, no clutch pedal

CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission)
Best for: City driving, fuel efficiency (Honda, Nissan, Maruti)
Pros: Smooth, no gear shifts at all
Watch out for: Rubber band feeling at high speed, CVT belt wear

AMT (Automated Manual Transmission)
Best for: Budget buyers (Maruti, Tata, Renault)
Pros: Affordable, better fuel efficiency than torque converter
Watch out for: Jerky gear changes, not as smooth as DSG/CVT

TORQUE CONVERTER (Traditional Automatic)
Best for: Comfort driving, SUVs (Hyundai, Toyota, BMW, Mercedes)
Pros: Very smooth, durable
Watch out for: Slightly less efficient than DSG

Whichever you drive - Sehmbi services ALL types.

Transmission Repair or Replacement - Which Do You Actually Need?

When your automatic gearbox fails, the workshop might say
'full replacement needed'. But is that always true?

At Sehmbi, we believe in fixing only what needs fixing.
Here is how we approach the repair vs replacement decision:

REPAIR IS USUALLY ENOUGH WHEN:
-> Specific solenoids or sensors have failed
-> Valve body issues are causing shift problems
-> Torque converter clutch is worn
-> Transmission fluid is degraded (service needed)
-> Individual clutch packs need replacement
-> Mechatronic unit faults

REPLACEMENT IS NEEDED WHEN:
-> Internal gear damage is catastrophic
-> The transmission casing is cracked
-> Multiple major internal components have failed simultaneously
-> The repair cost exceeds 70% of replacement cost

The truth: most automatic transmission failures
can be fixed with targeted repair - not a full replacement.
And that saves you lakhs.

Get an honest assessment from specialists who will
not upsell you an unnecessary replacement.
